how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-silithus-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1125:obj:0: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1125:details:0: To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village. This is where our work should begin, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:1125:details:1: BFrom what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for ⟦E1⟧. It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes. I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...
rows.quest:1125:details:2: BThe tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly. Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.
rows.quest:1125:completion:0: I had thought that maybe the huge swirling hive near the ruins of the village had played a part in its demise. It would seem that your work has proven this to be correct; the proximity of the hive poses a threat to any future work we may do here.
rows.quest:1125:completion:1: BI thank you for your benevolence in freeing the souls of the fallen; such work is never easy, I know. When you're ready, however, I'd like to ask for your assistance once more...
rows.quest:1126:obj:0: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1126:details:0: The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them. It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits.
rows.quest:1126:details:1: BThe silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it. Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity. Report back what you learn, but be careful! If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me.
rows.quest:1126:completion:1: BIt has the shape of a... box, maybe? It's encrusted over something fierce. Wait, there a portion here that's exposed... is that a book underneath all this gunk?
rows.quest:1126:completion:2: BI think you've stumbled across quite the find here, ⟦2⟧... well, at least I hope it is. Perhaps it is a journal or a log from ancient times, preserved in this shell.
rows.quest:1126:completion:3: BI think I know a way to find out what this is.
rows.quest:6844:obj:0: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6844:details:0: There's plenty to do here still, but I think taking this back to the Circle for analysis is key. Trust me - the work will still be here once this is all said and done. If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past!
rows.quest:6844:details:1: BTake this to the Circle's archivist in Nighthaven. His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant. Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless! Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this. If it can be saved, he can do it.
rows.quest:6844:completion:0: Well great monkey toads! What have you got here? It's sort of book shaped, I guess... I'll try crack this shell on it.
rows.quest:6844:completion:1: BLayo sent you to me from ⟦E1⟧? I've only heard very hushed rumblings - which I guess aren't all that hushed when you think about it - about the horrors that are going on out there. Couple that with my lack of pleasure for anything bug-like, and you've got the recipe for me needing to stay here with the books!
rows.quest:8277:obj:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
rows.quest:8277:details:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at your service! My cousin Noggle makes a living gathering rare herbs for Cenarion Hold alchemists. Or used to, anyway. He came back from his last trip with a strong poison running though his veins.
rows.quest:8277:details:1: BI've managed to slow down the venom, but to fully neutralize it I need poison samples from whatever stung him.
rows.quest:8277:details:2: BNoggle arrived from the north, so I'd bet my shirt stonelash scorpids or sand skitterers did it. Bring me some stingers and fangs and I'll try to make an antidote for him.
rows.quest:8277:completion:0: Cross your fingers, friend! Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
rows.quest:8278:obj:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
rows.quest:8278:details:0: Blasted! The antidote didn't work. Noggle must've been stung by one of the stronger creatures in the far south.
rows.quest:8278:details:1: BI'm going to need you to go there and get me some more samples, ⟦3⟧. The good news is that since their poison is stronger I won't require as many. The bad news is that there are more kinds of poisonous creatures crawling around the southern area so you'll have to draw from more sources.
rows.quest:8278:completion:0: Yes! It seems to be working, Noggle is coming to. We owe ya big time!
rows.quest:8279:obj:0: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8279:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ are not kind to those that leave their ranks. They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast! Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine!
rows.quest:8279:details:1: BTo decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations! The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ camps.
rows.quest:8279:completion:0: Yes! These are the parts to the book! Let's get started then, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:8279:completion:1: BSwap every third word with words from the second chapter... then swap every other word with words from the first chapter... Wait, did I get that backwards?
rows.quest:8280:obj:0: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
rows.quest:8280:details:0: Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance. I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed. Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is.
rows.quest:8280:details:1: BDesert worms have proven to be more of a threat to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves. Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers. I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized.
rows.quest:8280:completion:0: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
rows.quest:8281:obj:0: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
rows.quest:8281:details:0: Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, ⟦5⟧. Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however. In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.
rows.quest:8281:details:1: BYou'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance.
rows.quest:8281:completion:0: Excellent! You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.
rows.quest:8282:obj:0: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of ⟦E1⟧ and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8282:details:0: Where am I? Where's my bag? *gasp* I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid. In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers.
rows.quest:8282:details:1: BThe satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it. Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs. I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents.
rows.quest:8282:details:2: BI ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp.
rows.quest:8282:completion:0: Yes! You brought my satchel back. And my rare reagents are all here! I'll be in your debt for a long time.
rows.quest:8283:obj:0: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
rows.quest:8283:details:0: The terrible scorpid, Deathclasp, is believed to have retreated to the southern mountain range in the presence of increased silithid activity. She presents a great threat to patrols and expeditions in the southern regions. Individuals participating in her destruction will be remunerated handsomely. Inquire with Captain Vish Kozus, at the top of the Cenarion Hold Watchtower, regarding a reward.
rows.quest:8283:completion:0: Excellent! With Deathclasp gone we're free to use the southern mountain range as a strategic path to circumvent the silithid hives. Your work is greatly appreciated.
rows.quest:8284:obj:0: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
rows.quest:8284:details:0: A camp of Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ cultists once thrived northwest of here. If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was.
rows.quest:8284:details:1: BI've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful. See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ presence here in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8284:completion:0: Just as I suspected. I can decipher individual words in the tablets but they appear to be devoid of any logic or meaning. It's not unknown for Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ sects to use a code to hide the meaning of their texts; we'll have to go to someone who knows more about this sort of thing.
rows.quest:8285:obj:0: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in ⟦E1⟧.⟦6⟧
rows.quest:8285:details:0: There are rumors of a Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ member called Ortell having deserted his sect. Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit. Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet.
rows.quest:8285:details:1: BTake the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell.
rows.quest:8285:completion:0: I see you're familiar with my old organization. You must be with Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8285:completion:1: BYou seek information to use against them? Come closer, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.
rows.quest:8286:obj:0: Venture to the Caverns of Time in ⟦E4⟧ and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.
rows.quest:8286:details:0: The embrace of death had all but overcome my being when he intervened. He breathed only once upon my maimed body and then waited patiently for the sands of time to cleanse my wounds.
rows.quest:8286:details:1: B"Forever you will remain if you must", he said, and with those words I was bound as a Watcher.
rows.quest:8286:details:2: BLook now to the desert. The second war is upon us. You must seek out the resting place of the Bronze. Venture to the Caverns of Time and see if the master has returned. I must be sure before I am able to proceed.
rows.quest:8286:completion:0: It is as it should be - the great one has risen. My watch comes to an end...
rows.quest:8287:obj:0: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
rows.quest:8287:details:0: Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say! I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at ⟦E1⟧. They plan to drive the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ out, don't they? This will help.
rows.quest:8287:details:1: BTake this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith. Soon the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!
rows.quest:8287:completion:0: This is very interesting information indeed, ⟦7⟧. This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ in ⟦E1⟧ and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them. Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:8301:obj:0: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
rows.quest:8301:details:0: The Brood of Nozdormu are naturally distrusting of the lesser races. While it is true that you have proven to me that you have the potential makings of a hero, the time has come to prove this to my master.
rows.quest:8301:details:1: BHive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, Hive'Regal: All swarming with activity and all a threat to our existence. Slay silithid at these hives and take from them a fragment of their carapace. When you can carry no more, return to me and I shall strengthen your resolve.
rows.quest:8301:completion:0: You are not alone, hero. I will now grant you the ability to deputize others to help you in your quest. If you are to be the champion of your people, you will need assistance in your tasks and duties.
rows.quest:8303:obj:0: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8303:details:1: BI must apologize for keeping so much in secret. Enemies abound, even under our very noses. Please, read from this tome and learn. Take the knowledge I give to you and seek out our master.
rows.quest:8304:obj:0: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8304:obj:1: BOnce you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.
rows.quest:8304:details:0: My dear Natalia has gone missing.
rows.quest:8304:details:1: BTruth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research.
rows.quest:8304:details:2: BShe was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south.
rows.quest:8304:details:3: BMy soldiers are spread too thin, ⟦11⟧. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.
rows.quest:8304:completion:0: <Commander Mar'alith lowers his head in contemplation.>
rows.quest:8304:completion:1: BWhether she is alive or dead, I must do what is right. She must be found. Alas, I am bound by duty to this outpost. Will you help me once more, ⟦12⟧?
rows.quest:8305:obj:0: Locate the Crystalline Tear in ⟦E1⟧ and gaze into its depths.
rows.quest:8305:details:0: In the southern desert of ⟦E1⟧, near the sacred barrier, exists a single crystalline tear. This tear serves as a symbol of the great losses beset upon us during the War of the Shifting Sands. Locate this tear and gaze into its depths to gain enlightenment.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:8305:completion:0: You can feel a great sorrow revolving around this crystal. The force is so powerful that you feel as if you might collapse and die of sadness.
rows.quest:8306:obj:0: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
rows.quest:8306:obj:1: BDo not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.
rows.quest:8306:obj:2: BAnd ⟦14⟧, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."
rows.quest:8306:details:0: I need you to venture into Hive'Regal and find what became of my dearest Natalia, ⟦15⟧. This will be no easy task for you. Before you dive headlong into the maw of madness, make sure that you go back and speak with those dwarves. They might be able to give you some tips on dealing with the silithid that inhabit that hive.
rows.quest:8306:details:1: BAnd ⟦16⟧, if she truly is as mad as they say... do what you must.
rows.quest:8306:details:2: B<Commander Mar'alith turns away from you.>⟦17⟧
rows.quest:8306:completion:1: BC'Thun? WHAT is the meaning of all this? What is C'Thun? How could this fiend have turned my sweet Natalia into the monster that you described?
rows.quest:8308:obj:0: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8308:details:1: BIf you're reading this, I'm either dead or soon to be dead. It's hard to say. Most of the crew is dead anyhow.
rows.quest:8308:details:2: BFound information about a Titan. Great battle between him and an Old God. Yes, a bona fide Old God. Found ancient tunnel leading to Ahn'Qiraj. Taking it.
rows.quest:8308:details:3: BTake this letter to my old camp. Make sure my monkey is getting adequate food, water, and hugs.
rows.quest:8308:details:5: BP.S. Watch out for crazy Old God worshipping night elf.
rows.quest:8308:completion:0: Well this explains a lot. If you ever find a way into Ahn'Qiraj, keep an eye out for ol' Brann. I'm afraid that he'll be powerless without his monkey.
rows.quest:8309:obj:0: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive.
rows.quest:8309:obj:1: BUse the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.
rows.quest:8309:details:0: After our initial foray into the hives and Mistress Mar'alith's subsequent madness the three hives have been spewing out bugs! The increased activity might be tied into the glyphs covering those strange crystals.
rows.quest:8309:details:1: BWe must get a rubbing from crystals in all three hives. If we can get those rubbings, we might be able to make sense of this madness.
rows.quest:8309:details:2: BTake this transcription set and hit those hives, ⟦18⟧. Don't come back until you've gotten copies from each hive.
rows.quest:8309:completion:0: I can't make heads or tails of these glyphs. I've never seen anything like it! I hope Frankal's research can shed some light on this mess.
rows.quest:8310:obj:0: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:8310:details:0: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.
rows.quest:8310:completion:0: Outstanding! Don't wander off too far, kid. We might need you to take on another task or two.
rows.quest:8314:obj:0: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment wants you to deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8314:details:0: We're on the verge of a breakthrough, ⟦19⟧! The rubbings you recovered have allowed us to recreate the glyphs on this crystalline prism. They are apparently a means for the Qiraji and other unknown entities to communicate various messages to the silithid.
rows.quest:8314:details:1: BUnfortunately, that is all we could get out of the glyphs. We need to find a way to unlock the messages hidden within the crystals.
rows.quest:8314:details:2: BTake the glyphed crystal prism to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold. She might be able to help.
rows.quest:8314:completion:0: The reason the dwarves could not decipher the glyphs is because there is nothing to decipher. The shifting outer layer of the prism must properly align with the inner crystal's markings in order for the message to be transmitted. Clever...
rows.quest:8314:completion:1: BWhile we should be able to translate this data, we must first unlock the code. There is only one clue on the surface of the prism - assuming the rubbings were transferred correctly - and it looks grim.
rows.quest:8315:obj:0: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.
rows.quest:8315:obj:1: BYou have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.
rows.quest:8315:obj:2: BAssemble an army for this task, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:8315:details:0: The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon. Above the glyphs is what I can only assume to be a code of some sort. This code might very well be the key to summoning the emissary.
rows.quest:8315:details:1: BI will create a copy of the glyph code that you must use in the sand at the Bones of Grakkarond. If I am right, the Overlords will come thinking that new data is ready for transmission. Strike them down and confront the emissary. He holds the key to the crystals...
rows.quest:8315:completion:0: I hold 20,000 years of history in my hands, ⟦21⟧!
rows.quest:8316:completion:0: War comes, ⟦22⟧, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
rows.quest:8316:completion:1: BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
rows.quest:8316:completion:3: BThe future of us all could be at an end.
rows.quest:8316:completion:4: BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.
rows.quest:8318:obj:0: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8318:details:0: Some of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. I want you to bring me a stack of them, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:8318:details:1: BI can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point! These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly. The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate!
rows.quest:8318:completion:0: Excellent! I'll stash these away, maybe they'll be useful later.
rows.quest:8320:obj:0: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8320:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E3⟧, an insane cult bent on destruction, set up camps in ⟦E1⟧ and perform rituals day and night. We do not yet know their plans, but we do think they are somehow linked to the pulsing red crystals spread across the desert.
rows.quest:8320:details:1: BAlthough their mystery may one day be solved, we must first deal with their immediate threat. Go to their camps to the west and seek out Twilight geolords. They are the heads of these serpents; that is where we must strike!
rows.quest:8320:completion:0: That was a task well performed, ⟦25⟧. Your slaying of the Twilight geolords must have dealt a grievous blow to the cult. Let us hope their plans are slowed...
rows.quest:8321:obj:0: Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8321:details:0: We have discovered another base of operations for the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧. It is called Twilight's Run; it is a cave tucked in the northeast corner of ⟦E1⟧. The local leader of the cult, Vyral the Vile, haunts that cave - it is he who you must next defeat. When you have done this, bring me his signet ring.
rows.quest:8321:details:1: BFortune to you, ⟦26⟧. The horrors of Twilight's Run are formidable indeed.
rows.quest:8321:completion:0: You've done it! Vyral is killed! This can only mean doom for the ⟦E6⟧'s operations in ⟦E1⟧. There may be more of them scurrying about, but the blow you dealt to the cult today is one from which they will not easily recover.
rows.quest:8323:obj:0: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
rows.quest:8323:details:0: Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you.
rows.quest:8323:details:1: BMy former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis.
rows.quest:8323:details:2: BIf they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer.
rows.quest:8323:details:3: BAlthough this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share. Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ members.
rows.quest:8323:completion:0: Excellent! I will get to decoding these as soon as possible. If I find anything of interest I'll find some way to get the information to you.
rows.quest:8331:obj:0: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8331:details:0: ⟦27⟧, although we had hoped the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧'s operations in ⟦E1⟧ were slowing... we were, regrettably, mistaken. Through continued forays against the cult, we have learned that an even darker power, the Abyssal Council, controls the ⟦E3⟧ through the arcane wind stones dotted amongst the cult's camps. Your next action, ⟦28⟧, will be against the Abyssal Council.
rows.quest:8331:details:1: BSpeak with the craftsman Aurel Goldleaf, in the eastern section of Cenarion Hold. Her skill will be needed for this next gambit.
rows.quest:8331:completion:0: ⟦29⟧, good day. I was told you will pit yourself against the Abyssal Council? If that is so, then listen closely to my next words...
rows.quest:8332:obj:0: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8332:details:0: We think it is possible to use a wind stone to ambush a duke of the Abyssal Council. To do this, however, one must commune through the wind stone, and convince the council you are a middle ranked leader of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8332:details:1: BSuch a gambit requires a replica of the cult's medallion of station. I can create the medallion, but I will need a large brilliant shard, and crests worn by the Abyssal Templar.
rows.quest:8332:details:2: BBring these to me and I will do the rest.
rows.quest:8332:completion:0: Ah, very good. I've been working on the medallion - now with these last ingredients, I'll be done in just a few moments...
rows.quest:8332:completion:1: BThere we are. Here is the medallion, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:8332:completion:2: BYou'll need to wear this when you activate one of the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧'s wind stones. Put this on, along with the rest of the twilight trappings, and the Abyssal Council will see you as one of their cultist underlings.
rows.quest:8341:obj:0: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8341:details:0: Lords of the Abyssal Council can only be summoned through the greater wind stones, and only the top ranking members of the Twilight's Council may speak to them. But... I have found a way to upgrade your disguise and fool the Abyssal Lords!
rows.quest:8341:details:1: BThe disguise calls for a ring of lordship, worn only by the highest members of the cult. I will craft one for you if you can bring me large brilliant shards and abyssal signets.
rows.quest:8341:completion:0: Thanks. Just one moment and I'll have that ring ready for you...
rows.quest:8341:completion:1: BThere it is. Now you're ready.
rows.quest:8341:completion:2: BBe sure to wear this ring, along with a medallion of station and the rest of the twilight trappings, when you activate a greater wind stone. Do that, and the Abyssal Council will think you one of their servants. Then, perhaps you can lure one into an ambush!
rows.quest:8343:obj:0: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8343:details:0: ⟦31⟧, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council! Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle. We know that if anyone can do it, you can.
rows.quest:8343:details:1: BMay fortune go with you, ⟦32⟧. Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
rows.quest:8343:completion:0: What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...
rows.quest:8348:obj:0: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8348:details:0: Huum tells me you've figured out how to summon the Abyssal Dukes! That's quite an accomplishment.
rows.quest:8348:details:1: BYou know what else would be quite the accomplishment? Smashing up one of those things really good. That'll cause an impression on their underlings, if you know what I mean. Bring back its signet as proof of the deed.
rows.quest:8348:completion:0: I knew you were a tough ⟦33⟧ the minute I saw you walk into Cenarion Hold. Keep it up!
rows.quest:8349:obj:0: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8349:details:0: Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane. He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council.
rows.quest:8349:details:1: BGood luck, ⟦34⟧. And if you ever need more medallions, return to me.
rows.quest:8349:completion:0: Good to see you again, ⟦35⟧! So you had a medallion made? Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...
rows.quest:8351:obj:0: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8351:details:0: Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you. Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission...
rows.quest:8351:completion:0: Yes, that's right, ⟦36⟧. I have a very tough task ahead...
rows.quest:8352:obj:0: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8352:details:0: Huum and I were just talking about you. He tells me you're just about ready to try your hand at fighting an Abyssal Lord!
rows.quest:8352:details:1: BI must tell you this is a very dangerous endeavor. You'd better bring backup. And I don't mean one or two of your friends, I'm talking about a top-notch, battle-ready fighting force. If your friends are as good as you, you might even defeat it!
rows.quest:8352:details:2: BIf you do - and I'll want evidence, as always - I'll give you a truly great reward.
rows.quest:8352:completion:0: You... you did it! You did it, ⟦37⟧! Here! Take this. It's the biggest chest we had lying around and I filled it with some of the best stuff we found.
rows.quest:8361:obj:0: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.
rows.quest:8361:details:0: We've seen the Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ cultists performing rituals to summon powerful elemental nobles. We don't know if these are the beings the cultists worship or if they act as intermediaries to even more powerful forces. One thing is for sure: they are receiving orders from these elementals.
rows.quest:8361:details:1: BI want you to find a way to contact an Abyssal Templar and give it a proper beating! Nothing throws the troops in disarray like taking out the chain of command. Bring back proof while you're at it.
rows.quest:8361:completion:0: Hah! You did it, ⟦38⟧! The Twilight's ⟦E3⟧ will soon be crushed!
rows.quest:8376:completion:0: War comes, ⟦39⟧, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
rows.quest:8376:completion:1: BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
rows.quest:8376:completion:3: BThe future of us all could be at an end.
rows.quest:8376:completion:4: BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.
rows.quest:8377:completion:0: War comes, ⟦41⟧, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
rows.quest:8377:completion:1: BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
rows.quest:8377:completion:3: BThe future of us all could be at an end.
